rung_purposes.purpose: Initialize station setpoints: fill threshold D122, max drop D120, overpressure limit D123.
Detect pack pressure sensor wire break or under-range condition (< -500).
Latch overpressure alarm M291 if pack pressure exceeds threshold D123.
Latch supply air pressure low alarm M293 if air drops while station is busy.
Reset latched alarms M290, M291, and M293 upon pressing fault reset PB X1.
Summarize station fault state into M299 and drive fault beacon Y25.
Energize vent valve Y22 via manual vent PB X25 in manual mode.
Start auto cycle at Step 1 (Clamp) when pallet arrives without active faults.
Advance Step 1 (Clamp) to Step 2 (Fill) once clamp closed limit is confirmed.
Run fill timeout timer T21 during Step 2 (Fill).
Latch fill timeout alarm M290 if timer T21 elapses.
Advance Step 2 (Fill) to Step 3 (Stabilise) once target pressure D122 is reached.
Run stabilisation timer T22 during Step 3 (Stabilise).
Capture initial test pressure D110 when test timer T23 triggers.
Advance Step 3 (Stabilise) to Step 4 (Test) upon completion of timer T22.
Run leak test window timer T23 during Step 4 (Test).
Capture final pressure D111 and compute pressure drop D112 when T23 elapses.
Compare pressure drop D112 against max limit D120 to latch PASS M210 or FAIL M211.
Advance Step 4 (Test) to Step 5 (Vent) when test timer T23 completes.
Abort cycle on fault M299 by forcing step sequence to Step 5 (Vent) and latching FAIL.
Run vent timer T200 during Step 5 (Vent).
Advance Step 5 (Vent) to Step 6 (Unclamp) when pressure is low and vent timer expires.
Advance Step 6 (Unclamp) to Step 7 (Complete) once clamp open limit is confirmed.
Clear cycle busy and complete flags when pallet departs test position X23.
Energize clamp solenoid Y20 throughout steps 1 to 5.
Energize fill valve Y21 during Step 2 when no fault is present.
Energize vent valve Y22 during Step 5 (Vent) or on overpressure alarm M291.
Output PASS (Y23) or FAIL (Y24) result to line controller during Step 7.
End of ladder program execution.
